verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own docs say browser agents can be deployed and run 'on a schedule or on demand', which directly claims recurring execution. Marketing copy about agents that run 'continuously' and track changes 'as they happen' supports the recurring-use case. However, scheduling appears only as a single one-line mention, with no detail on how schedules are defined, managed or monitored. missing for 10: documented schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax, API or dashboard schedule management), schedule run history and failure handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of recurring runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
Run agents that click through your product continuously and alert you the moment something breaks.
